sources.notes: Aesthetic input, never factual authority. Panel D surface rhythm and closed cutaway retained. Its small side sketch looks symmetric, reject it: explicit analytic asymmetric cross-sections are long gentle +Y-to-Ydecreasing stoss and short steep downcurrent -Y lee. Use 8 ridges with gently sinuous crest drift across X, no random faceting, no water/fossils/burrows. Slab surface is a single continuous top mesh with actual relief and a closed cutaway underside; quiet edge border only, not additional scenic platform.
